manifestations.invariant: After a weather closure, each gate entry leaves a scanned pass with prorated credit and an invalidation recorded exactly once.

contract_bindings.quote:
The gate scanner writes one ledger entry for a pass in each lift window. A
second tap in the same window is refused, while a later window remains valid.

The weather closure table uses the scanned windows to determine a prorated
credit for the unused part of a pass.
